sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders are in excellent form, unbeaten in their last five matches (four wins and a draw), and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday; Stafford are just two points behind the leaders but have drawn their last match, while Dawley come in on the back of a win. The battle for top honours continues with AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) hosting Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a direct challenge between high-performing sides, though Bridgnorth suffered their first loss in recent matches last time out. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points with strong recent form, travel away to Wednesfield Community, who have won their last match but remain inconsistent. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) are in good shape heading to Foley Meir, while Barnton entertain Shawbury United—Barnton's mixed recent form contrasts sharply with Shawbury's run of five consecutive losses. In the lower reaches, Market Drayton Town host New Mills (both mid-table strugglers), Crewe face a steep challenge away at in-form Allscott Heath, and Brereton Social visit Widnes Town, whose 2 points from 7 games represents the division's poorest record. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in another clash between sides battling at the bottom.
